articles.title: CENAP: Germany's Central Hub for UFO Sightings and Scientific Explanations
articles.summary: CENAP: Germany's Central Hub for UFO Sightings and Scientific Explanations The Central Research Network for Extraordinary Celestial Phenomena (CENAP) has become the primary contact point in Germany for individuals seeking scientific explanations of unusual sky observations. According to CENAP director Hansjurgen Kohler, the organisation has never received as many reports as it does now, with three to six new cases arriving daily, making it the busiest reporting centre in the German-speaking world. From amateur beginnings to a national clearinghouse Kohler, an amateur astronomer, said his involvement began with youthful recklessness while working at an observatory.

articles.title: Exclusive: Brussels keen to monitor UFOs under the radar
articles.summary: Brussels has signalled it is monitoring unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) and has hinted at improving capabilities, according to documents seen by Euronews. The European Commission seems to have been monitoring unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) under the radar since at least 2023, according to a document from the Commission's defence department seen by Euronews, which pertains to sky and space observations in Malaysia. "We are getting better at seeing it (UAPs) and better identifying it as our technological capacities improve, but we need to get even better," the letter read, signalling the EU executive is actively monitoring the phenomenon more than officially stated and seems keen to investigate it.
